user.title: Add room
user.description: One entry controls the lights of one room.

data_description.presence_sensors: Lights turn on when any of these is on.
data_description.dark_sensor: When this sensor is on, it counts as dark.
data_description.lux_sensor: Below the threshold the room counts as dark. Without darkness and lux sensor, the sun is used.
data_description.off_delay: How long the room must be empty before lights turn off.
data_description.dim_before_off: Lights stay dimmed this long as a warning. 0 = off immediately.
data_description.night_lights: Only these lights are used at night and in sleep mode. Empty = all.
data_description.media_entity: While it is on, the room counts as occupied and uses TV mode.
data_description.sleep_entity: When on, sleep mode applies in addition to the room switch.

light.title: Light per time of day
light.description: Night applies within the night window, evening after sunset, day otherwise. TV applies while the TV is on; sleep overrides everything.

error.night_lights_not_in_room: Night lights must also be selected as lights.
